design_rationale:
# Task 1 dossier — keeping a hail-totaled truck (physical_damage_claims_and_total_loss)

## 0. Draw and scope
draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]}.
Assignment: physdmg_ext_kept_vehicle_settlement (root, user) = 5 factors; physdmg_ext_claim_free_credit (agent) = 6.
Occupied by task 0: accident deductible, surrender settlement, loan payoff benefit and their three tools. Claimed here: the Deductible
Rewards claim-free credit and the blueprint's second customer decision, keeping the salvage, with tools grant_claim_free_credit_c23d8d33
(agent) and keep_total_loss_vehicle_b04c3b51 (user). The five policies are covered exactly once; no tool is shared.
Why a good test: Harold asks only to settle while keeping his truck. The kept-vehicle settlement's rule waits on a Deductible Rewards
balance carrying every completed claim-free year; the records show a year ending 2026-09-20 that is complete only if the agent knows the
January glass repair does not restart the year. The agent must post that six-factor credit and then compute a five-factor kept-vehicle
settlement and hand it over; one ladder counts tenure to the grant date (120 months) and another to the loss date (119 months).

## 1. Problem-tree card
Root: physdmg_ext_kept_vehicle_settlement (user; on_request: "you want to keep the truck").
Edge: kept settlement -> claim-free credit, value_input (credit_balance), form state. Sentence (negated direction): "The kept-vehicle
settlement is not worked out until the vehicle's Deductible Rewards balance carries a credit for every completed claim-free year." Only
grant_claim_free_credit_c23d8d33 writes claim-free credits. Derivation: sentence + records (credits end 2024-09-20 and 2025-09-20; glass
repair paid 2026-01-15 with no deductible) + the credit rule (a glass repair with no deductible does not restart the year; the year ends 12
months after the anchor) -> a credit for the year ending 2026-09-20.
False at frozen_time 2026-10-05: latest credit entry ends 2025-09-20; balance 420.00. Order: credit (step 12) then settlement (step 14).
Deletion sensitivity: without step 12 the balance stays 420.00, kept net deductible 140.00, settlement 11,104.00 instead of 11,244.00.
No user hint: the persona's guard line is "You don't know Cardinal's rules"; no credit, reward or claim-free wording. Tools do not block.

## 2. Base-invariant card
Step 12 (physdmg_deductible_credit_earned): physdmg_deductible_rewards; its once-per-period clause is restated by the extended rule ('a year
whose end date has already been credited is never credited again'), declared in overwrite with the claim-free-months clause. No entry ends
2026-09-20. Step 14 (physdmg_total_loss_declared): physdmg_total_loss policy_scope; 9,840.00 >= 70 percent x 13,200.00 (IN); owned, no
loss payee; owner_retained_salvage_allowed true. No time gate on either write.

## 3. Business-object card
Coverage 67ef8986… (2016 Silverado, $1,000 option, no loss payee). Credits: enrollment 2023-09-20 (100), 2024-09-20 (110), 2025-09-20
(210). Claims: glass PD-2026-0109227 (95.00 to the shop, deductible 0.00, closed paid 2026-01-15); hail PD-2026-0907318 (decision
560.00, estimate 9,840.00, declared 2026-09-18). The Ranger (added 2026-09-28) carries no coverage and is read for the tax basis. Billing:
Card Autopay; the ledger's only returned payment is 2024-03-12 (with its 25.00 NSF fee and make-up payment; balance 0.00).

## 4. Factor card (handling-time run)
Claim-free credit (expected 250.00; all-baseline 0.00):
- non_restarting_claims (method): glass repair, no deductible -> anchor 2025-09-20 (baseline anchors on 2026-01-15 -> 0.00). Near-miss:
  the January claim is a paid claim that would restart the year under the plain anchor rule.
- loyalty_escalator: two earlier credits -> 150 (baseline -> 200.00).
- package_credit_cap (auto): Preferred -> option maximum 500 raised by 250 = 750 (baseline 500 -> room 80 -> 80.00); the Preferred tier
  raises the cap on every option.
- drivesense_credit_bonus (telematics): 91 -> +50 (baseline -> 200.00).
- tenure_credit_bonus (auto): 120 months to the grant -> +25 (baseline -> 225.00).
- payment_record_bonus (billing): autopay, no return within 12 months -> +25 (baseline -> 225.00). Near-miss: the 2024-03-12 return is on
  the ledger but outside the window.
Kept-vehicle settlement (expected 11,244.00; all-baseline 11,982.50):
- salvage_value_basis (method): bid valid (17 days) below the 25 percent floor -> 3,300.00 (baseline bid -> 11,559.00).
- kept_vehicle_loyalty_discount (auto): 119 months to the loss -> 10 percent (baseline -> 10,914.00). Near-miss: the policy is ten
  calendar years old by the grant date and earns the long-tenure credit bonus there, but counted to the 2026-09-07 loss it is one month
  short of 120, so the 20 percent tier does not apply.
- retained_equipment: drivable, estimate below 80 percent of ACV -> none (baseline -> 12,244.00).
- retitling_allowance (auto): IN -> 75.00 (baseline -> 11,169.00).
- kept_vehicle_tax_basis (method, auto): Ranger added after the loss -> tax on the full kept value 924.00 (baseline tax on kept value less
  salvage deduction 716.10 -> 11,036.10).
Overrides declared: physdmg_deductible_rewards (claim-free months clause; once-per-period clause); physdmg_total_loss composition sentence
and new-car-replacement sentence (a kept vehicle is valued at ACV in every case).

## 5. Seed rationale and history consistency
Glass decision 0.00 and hail decision 560.00 follow the accepted-claim deductible rule (hail: 1,000 capped at 750 Preferred, -50 loyalty
for 119 months, DriveSense 91 -> 20 percent off). Credits: 2024-09-20 = 100 + 10 tenure (96 months), returned payment inside 12 months ->
110; 2025-09-20 = 125 + 50 + 10 + 25 = 210 (room under 750). Billing ledger sums to 0.00. No automatic clause fires.

## 6. Persona
Harold, retired, plain-spoken; wants to keep the truck and settle now (a write); phone, then ZIP, then DOB only on a third request; claim
number, no lien, drivable only when asked; lets the agent put on his account whatever must come first; completes the hand-over with the
agent's figures; hangs up once told the kept-vehicle settlement is recorded. He mentions the Ranger purchase as natural context (in
initial_state), never any credit or rule.

## 7. Standard solution and verification
Writes: step 12 grant_claim_free_credit(67ef8986…, 2026-09-20, 250.00); step 14 user keep_total_loss_vehicle(PD-2026-0907318, 11244.00).
Scratch evaluator over handling-time worlds printed 250.0 and 11244.0 with every factor baseline different; check_compute agrees.

## 8. Revision log
Round 2 (policy-task audit): P-1 kept-vehicle rule now declares the new-car-replacement override (a kept vehicle is valued at ACV); T-1
retitling allowance now 'added to the kept-vehicle settlement'; F-7 tax-basis ladder rebuilt on replacement purchase (full value with a
replacement, none within the 30-day window, net of salvage otherwise); K-NM near-miss via inception 2016-09-20 (119 months to the loss);
C-1 persona guard line no longer names credits or settlements; claim-free credit Preferred cap changed (see round 3).
Seed: inception/customer_since 2016-09-20, package Preferred, hail decision 560.00 (revised deductible rule). Figures 235.00 / 11,036.10
-> 250.00 / 11,244.00.
Round 3 (revision 2 of the audit): N-2 the Preferred credit cap is now the option's deductible_rewards_max_credit raised by
preferred_cap_uplift (250), so the Preferred tier raises the cap on every option ($500 option 750 > 500; $250 option 500 > 250) and never
falls below the basic cap; on this $1,000 option it is 750 as before, so every figure of this task (250.00 / 11,244.00) is unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Harold Lindgren, 68, a retired tool-and-die maker in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The hail storm on September 7 beat up your 2016 Chevy Silverado from hood to tailgate, and Cardinal's adjuster wrote to say the truck is a total loss. It still starts and drives fine, and you want to keep the truck: you haul firewood and take it up to the lake, and you already bought a used 2021 Ford Ranger on September 28 for running around town. You are calling to settle the claim today with you keeping the Silverado, and you mean to go through with it on this call, not just hear a number.

You speak plainly and a little slowly, and you like to hear figures said out loud. When the agent asks for something to find you, you give your phone number, 2605550152. Asked for something to confirm it is you, you give your ZIP code, 46815; only if the agent wants yet another detail do you give your date of birth, 1958-02-14. If the agent asks for the claim number, you read it off the adjuster's letter: PD-2026-0907318. If asked whether anybody holds a loan on the Silverado, you say no, it's paid off. If asked whether the truck can be driven, you say yes, it runs fine, it just looks like a golf ball.

You don't know Cardinal's rules and you don't guess at any figure. If the agent says something has to be put on your account or worked out on their end first, you tell them to go right ahead. When the agent tells you the settlement figure for keeping the truck and hands the acceptance over to you, you complete it with the claim number and the figure exactly as the agent gave them. You never bring up any other matter.

Once the agent tells you the settlement with you keeping the truck is recorded, you thank them and hang up.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate Harold Lindgren's profile from the phone number he gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs his customer reference; the profile holds the credentials the verification compares.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with two credentials he states: phone number and ZIP code.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any claim detail, credit or settlement is handled.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the auto policy: Cardinal Auto Preferred, in_force, policy_state IN, inception 2016-09-20.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The package sets the credit cap; the inception date sets the tenure credit bonus (counted to the grant date) and the kept-vehicle loyalty discount (counted to the loss date); the state sets tax, title fee and the retitling allowance.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Silverado's coverage: $1,000 option, active, Deductible Rewards enrolled with a 420.00 balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The option's annual credit, collision deductible and custom equipment limit, and the credit balance, enter both computations.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the hail-damaged 2016 Silverado is owned outright (no lienholder) and see the 2021 Ranger bought on 2026-09-28.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: An owned vehicle with no loss payee can be kept as owner-retained salvage; the Ranger is the replacement that decides the kept-vehicle tax basis.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Silverado's claim file: glass claim PD-2026-0109227 (glass repair, deductible 0.00, closed paid 2026-01-15) and hail claim PD-2026-0907318 (loss 2026-09-07, drivable, accepted with a 560.00 deductible, estimate 9,840.00, declared a total loss on 2026-09-18 with ACV 13,200.00, salvage bid 2,950.00, custom equipment 1,350.00).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the paid glass claim the claim-free year rule examines and every figure of the kept-vehicle settlement.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Deductible Rewards entries (enrollment 2023-09-20, claim-free credits ending 2024-09-20 and 2025-09-20) and the 95.00 glass payment with no deductible taken.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the unresolved prerequisite (no credit for the year ending 2026-09-20) and the counts and dates the credit rule reads.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the auto transactions, including the Ranger added effective 2026-09-28.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A vehicle added after the 2026-09-07 loss decides the kept-vehicle tax basis.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Silverado's DriveSense Plug-In enrollment: scored, final score 91.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The score decides the DriveSense credit bonus.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the billing account: Card Autopay plan, autopay enrolled.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Autopay enrollment decides the payment-record bonus.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the billing ledger: the only returned payment posted on 2024-03-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No returned payment within the last 12 months keeps the payment-record bonus at its autopay tier.
First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Grant the Deductible Rewards credit for the claim-free year ending 2026-09-20 on the Silverado's coverage.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: physdmg_ext_claim_free_credit computes amount; the kept-vehicle settlement is not worked out until this credit stands.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.coverage_id: Value 67ef8986-036c-42f7-bd54-3a3ed181e261. Basis: the coverage finder returns one physical damage coverage for Harold, the Silverado's $1,000 option, which holds the Deductible Rewards entries; the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the vehicle's physical damage coverage'. Uniqueness: Harold has no other coverage (the Ranger carries none).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_period_end: Value 2026-09-20. Basis: the rule 'the year credited runs from the period anchor and ends claim_free_months months later, on the same day of the month'; the anchor stays 2025-09-20 (latest credit end) because the latest paid claim, the 2026-01-15 glass repair, took no deductible ('Claims that do not restart the year'). Uniqueness: restarting from the glass payment date would give a year ending 2027-01-15 that is not complete; the 2025-09-20 year is already credited.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 250.00 = min(150 + 50 + 25 + 25, 750 - 420). Anchor 2025-09-20 -> 12 whole months to 2026-10-05, so a credit is due. Loyalty escalator: two claim-free-year credits already -> 150. DriveSense: scored, 91 -> +50. Tenure: inception 2016-09-20 to the 2026-10-05 grant = 120 whole months -> +25. Payment record: Card Autopay, the only returned payment (2024-03-12) outside 12 months -> +25. Cap: Preferred -> the option's 500 maximum credit raised by 250 = 750; room 750 - 420 = 330.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the keep-the-vehicle settlement tool and hand it to Harold with the claim number and the settlement figure.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Choosing to keep the salvage and accepting the settlement is the customer's own decision; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Harold keeps the Silverado and accepts the kept-vehicle settlement in person.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: physdmg_ext_kept_vehicle_settlement computes settlement_amount; this is the root request.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.claim_number: Value PD-2026-0907318. Basis: the claim file shows the hail claim declared a total loss on 2026-09-18 under this number, and Harold reads 'PD-2026-0907318' from the adjuster's letter. Uniqueness: the other claim, PD-2026-0109227, is a closed glass repair.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.settlement_amount: Value 11,244.00 = 13,200.00 + 924.00 + 15.00 + 0.00 + 75.00 - 0.00 - 2,970.00. Kept value 13,200.00 (actual cash value; no prior damage; a kept vehicle never takes replacement cost). Salvage value: bid 17 days old (valid) and 2,950.00 below 25 percent of ACV -> floor 3,300.00; loyalty discount: inception 2016-09-20 is 119 whole months before the 2026-09-07 loss (>= 60, < 120) -> 10 percent -> salvage deduction 2,970.00. Tax basis: Ranger added effective 2026-09-28 after the loss -> tax on the full kept value 13,200.00 at Indiana 7 percent = 924.00. Title fee 15.00. Retained equipment: drivable and 9,840.00 below 80 percent of ACV -> 0.00. Retitling: Indiana -> 75.00. Kept net deductible: 560.00 less balance 670.00 applied up to it -> 0.00.

factor_trace: non_restarting_claims (method): latest paid claim PD-2026-0109227 is a glass repair with deductible_applied 0.00 -> anchor stays 2025-09-20 -> 12 whole months. Baseline anchors on the 2026-01-15 payment (8 months) -> 0.
package_credit_cap (parameter, auto): Preferred -> 500 maximum credit raised by 250 = 750, room 330. Baseline cap 500 -> room 80 -> 80.00.
tenure_credit_bonus (parameter, auto): inception 2016-09-20, 120 whole months to the grant -> +25. Baseline 0 -> 225.00.
payment_record_bonus (parameter, billing): autopay true, returned payments in 12 months 0 (the 2024-03-12 return is outside) -> +25. Baseline 0 -> 225.00.

request_alignment.claim: The customer asks to settle his hail total-loss claim today while keeping the truck himself.
evidence: user_scenario:you want to keep the truck
user_scenario:You are calling to settle the claim today with you keeping the Silverado

gold_actions.business_effect: Grants a 250.00 claim-free-year credit for the year ending 2026-09-20 on the Silverado's coverage, raising the Deductible Rewards balance from 420.00 to 670.00.

request_binding.action_semantics: The coverage holds credits for years ending 2024-09-20 and 2025-09-20; the year from 2025-09-20 ended on 2026-09-20 without a paid claim that restarts it (the January glass repair took no deductible), so its credit is owed on the records alone (state_due); it is the state the kept-vehicle settlement waits on and only this policy grants claim-free credits.

discriminator.business_meaning: a completed claim-free year with no credit entry

stage_provenance.fact: The credit for the completed year is granted by this call; the year's completion rests on the pre-existing credit and claim-payment records.

base_preconditions.condition: Deductible Rewards is enrolled on an option with deductible_rewards_available true; the base one-credit-per-period gate is restated by the extended claim-free credit rule (overwrite), and no credit entry ends on 2026-09-20.

gold_actions.business_effect: Harold keeps the Silverado as owner-retained salvage and accepts the 11,244.00 kept-vehicle settlement on PD-2026-0907318.

request_binding.action_semantics: The customer asks to settle the total loss while keeping the vehicle, which selects the kept-vehicle settlement accepted by the customer and not the surrender settlement.

user_scenario:you want to keep the truck

base_preconditions.condition: The Silverado is a total loss: the 9,840.00 estimate is at or above Indiana's 70 percent of the 13,200.00 actual cash value (9,240.00); the vehicle is owned with no loss payee and owner-retained salvage is allowed on the option.

Glass claim PD-2026-0109227, rock-chip glass breakage reported on the loss day.
Accepted under comprehensive with 0.00: glass repair deductible 0; the cap, loyalty and DriveSense steps leave 0 (the accepted-claim deductible rule).
Glass repair at a Cardinal Select Shop, 95.00.
Closed as paid on 2026-01-15 with its only payment.
Hail claim PD-2026-0907318: loss 2026-09-07 reported 2026-09-08 (1 day, timely), vehicle drivable, only claim of its occurrence.

Accepted under comprehensive with 560.00: comprehensive deductible 1,000 capped at 750 (Preferred), -50 loyalty (inception 119 months before the loss), DriveSense score 91 -> reduced 20 percent, no waiver on comprehensive — the accepted-claim deductible rule.
Hail estimate 9,840.00 at a Select Shop.

Enrollment credit 100.00 on 2023-09-20 ($1,000 option enrollment credit 100).

Year 2023-09-20 to 2024-09-20 credited 110.00 under the claim-free credit rule: first claim-free credit 100, tenure 96 months (+10), no DriveSense yet, returned payment of 2024-03-12 within 12 months (no payment bonus); cap 750 (Preferred).
Year to 2025-09-20 credited 210.00: second credit 125, DriveSense 91 (+50), tenure 108 months (+10), autopay with the 2024-03-12 return outside 12 months (+25); room under the 750 cap.
95.00 to the Select Shop for the glass repair, deductible_applied 0.00.

edges.condition: The coverage's physdmg_payments include a claim_free_year credit entry for every claim-free year whose end date has passed, and deductible_credit_balance includes those credits.
edges.policy_source: The kept-vehicle settlement is not worked out until the vehicle's Deductible Rewards balance carries a credit for every completed claim-free year.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The latest credit entry ends 2025-09-20; the only claim paid since (the 2026-01-15 glass repair, no deductible taken) does not restart the year, so the claim-free year ending 2026-09-20 is complete but no credit entry covers it and the balance stays 420.00.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 12 adds a claim_free_year credit entry ending 2026-09-20 for 250.00 and raises deductible_credit_balance to 670.00; the kept net deductible falls from 140.00 to 0.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: One edge, one prerequisite: the credit must land before the settlement reads the balance; the reverse order gives a different settlement (11,104.00) and so a different terminal state.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping step 12 leaves the balance at 420.00: kept net deductible 560.00 - 420.00 = 140.00 and the kept-vehicle settlement 11,104.00 instead of 11,244.00; the terminal state also lacks the 250.00 credit entry and the 670.00 balance.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to settle the claim keeping the truck; nowhere does it mention Deductible Rewards, reward credits or a claim-free year ('You don't know Cardinal's rules'); it says only that he lets the agent do whatever must be put on his account first. No policy id appears.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: keep_total_loss_vehicle_b04c3b51 creates the settlement row without reading the credit entries or the balance; grant_claim_free_credit_c23d8d33 creates the credit entry and updates the balance without checking any period; neither raises or returns an error.
